lines.text: Jephthah's brothers drive him out, and he settles in the land of Tob, where worthless men gather around him.
When the Ammonites make war on Israel, the elders of Gilead fetch Jephthah from Tob to be their commander.
The elders call the LORD their witness, and Jephthah repeats all his terms before the LORD at Bethel.
Edom and Moab refuse Israel passage, and Sihon king of the Amorites gathers his people at Gilgal and fights Israel.
Jephthah says Israel has lived in Heshbon for three hundred years, but the Ammonite king ignores his message.
